source: 1968 Chevrolet Chassis Service Manual, Corvette Body, p.1B-4

procedures.title: Console assembly: remove
steps: Remove the rear console first (or loosen it enough), because it overlaps the front console (see figure 6 in the manual).
Remove the 2 screws on the left and right sides of the rear console.
With the right rear storage compartment box out, remove the 1 hex bolt and washer at the center of the underbody panel.
Lift the rear console housing straight up, keeping it clear of the parking brake handle.
With the left and right side trim panels out, remove the 2 screws at the side flanges of the front console.
Disassemble the heater and side vent controls, shift knob, boot and trim plate.
Pull the front console rearward and upward to remove it (see figure 7 in the manual).
notes: Protect the seat cushion with a sheet of heavy cardboard pressed against it while using the screwdriver on the rear console screws.

procedures.title: Outside rear view mirror: remove and install
steps: Loosen/remove the allen head set screw on the outboard side of the mirror support to take the mirror off the door (see figure 8 in the manual).
Remove the 2 screws holding the mounting assembly to the body.

procedures.title: Inside rear view mirror: install and tension
steps: Install as shown in figure 9 in the manual.
Tighten the adjusting screw to increase mirror stud tension.
